   702  class ContextTlv : public NetworkDataTlv
   703  {
   704  public:
   705      /**
   706       * This method initializes the TLV.
   707       *
   708       */
   709      void Init(void)
   710      {
   711          NetworkDataTlv::Init();
   712          SetType(kTypeContext);
   713          SetLength(2);
   714          mFlags         = 0;
   715          mContextLength = 0;
   716      }
   717
   718      /**
   719       * This method indicates whether or not the Compress flag is set.
   720       *
   721       * @retval TRUE   The Compress flag is set.
   722       * @retval FALSE  The Compress flags is not set.
   723       *
   724       */
   725      bool IsCompress(void) const { return (mFlags & kCompressFlag) != 0; }
   726
   727      /**
   728       * This method clears the Compress flag.
   729       *
   730       */
   731      void ClearCompress(void) { mFlags &= ~kCompressFlag; }
   732
   733      /**
   734       * This method sets the Compress flag.
   735       *
   736       */
   737      void SetCompress(void) { mFlags |= kCompressFlag; }
   738
   739      /**
   740       * This method returns the Context ID value.
   741       *
   742       * @returns The Context ID value.
   743       *
   744       */
   745      uint8_t GetContextId(void) const { return mFlags & kContextIdMask; }
   746
   747      /**
   748       * This method sets the Context ID value.
   749       *
   750       * @param[in]  aContextId  The Context ID value.
   751       *
   752       */
   753      void SetContextId(uint8_t aContextId)
   754      {
   755          mFlags = (mFlags & ~kContextIdMask) | ((aContextId << kContextIdOffset) & kContextIdMask);
   756      }
   757
   758      /**
   759       * This method returns the Context Length value.

   764      uint8_t GetContextLength(void) const { return mContextLength; }

   768       *
   769       * @param[in]  aLength  The Context Length value.
   770       *
   771       */
   772      void SetContextLength(uint8_t aLength) { mContextLength = aLength; }
   773
   774  private:
   775      enum
   776      {
   777          kCompressFlag    = 1 << 4,
   778          kContextIdOffset = 0,
   779          kContextIdMask   = 0xf << kContextIdOffset,
   780      };
   781      uint8_t mFlags;
   782      uint8_t mContextLength;
   783  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;
